recovery_contract: Future chats must recover the Dropbox object through the GitHub V203/V204 authority receipt and require the exact SHA-256 before use. The user does not need to upload the catalog again while that durable object remains accessible.
prohibitions: Do not state that the ZIP binary itself is committed to GitHub unless a later receipt proves it byte-for-byte.
Do not accept a reconstructed catalog whose SHA-256 differs from the canonical value.
